Add custom content

Import custom blocks, props/assets (using Blockbench), and decals with only a few clicks.

Custom blocks

Import your texture (16x16px) and watch Splatico automatically create cube,slab,stairs, ramp and wall block variants.

Custom props

Design props using our official Blockbench plugin and import it directly within the map editor.

Custom assets

Add your own static assets like chairs or statues to fill your map using our official Blockpench plugin.

Custom decals

Use decals to add more details like posters and variance to your map. Import your texture (16x16px) and import with one click.
